notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Priest of Titania.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.
